items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My older sister her name was Olivvia.

ctx.x: Anthony Brown: How many brothers and sisters did you have total?
Olivvia, Melinda, Anna May, and Edith
So that was four sisters. How many brothers did you have?

items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my mother’s name was uh, Henry, Henry Jones Senior. And my mother’s name was Olivia.

ctx.x: Anthony Brown: Okay, great. And could you give us the names of your parents?
Elvin Jones: Uh, my father’s name was uh, Henry, Henry Jones Senior. And my mother’s name was Olivia. With two v’s! O-l-i-v-v-i-a.
Anthony Brown: Great, Great. And where were they originally from?
